roles.intro: A role decides which pages its users can open; that is what this editor changes. What they can do on those pages comes with the role a custom role is based on. Anyone who manages both users and roles is a Super Admin and opens every page, whatever their role lists.

roles.needPage: Grant at least one page to this role.
roles.needBase: Pick a role to base this one on.
roles.name: Role Name
roles.basedOnHint: What this role can do (not just which pages) starts as a copy of the role you pick here.
